$description: Every full page. tools/build_pages.py writes <path>index.html for each, with theme boot, CSS, social metadata and the page module. Embed routes (/embed/<component>/) are generated from components/*/ automatically; do not list them here.

pages.title: NightCal — what's on in Downtown Santa Rosa tonight
pages.description: Live music, comedy, shows and trivia in downtown Santa Rosa, tonight and this week. Every listing cites where it came from.

pages.title: AVR+JIT — the NightCal zine
pages.description: Reviews, articles and letters about downtown nights, mapped as a graph of the rooms and shows they talk about.

pages.title: NightCal in 3D — AR preview
pages.description: The same week and the same zine map as a 3D scene you can walk around, with WebXR AR where the device supports it.

pages.title: NightCal design system
pages.description: Tokens, themes, components, embed routes and the theme API behind NightCal.

pages.title: Landing page options — NightCal
pages.description: Three candidate front doors for NightCal, for the owner to choose between.

pages.title: Option A: Tonight first — NightCal
pages.description: Landing option A. Opens on tonight's listings, with the calendar and the zine one step away.

pages.title: Option B: Two doors — NightCal
pages.description: Landing option B. One sentence on what this is, then two equal doors: the calendar and the zine.

pages.title: Option C: Three steps — NightCal
